verdict.rationale: vLLM's own docs list PowerPC CPUs as a supported inference target alongside x86 and ARM, so the product directly provides at least one non-x86/ARM CPU architecture. That support rests on a single feature-list line, and no other CPU architecture beyond x86, ARM and PowerPC is evidenced, so the 'diverse' part of the story is only partly shown. missing for 10: dedicated PowerPC installation/build documentation, evidence of other non-x86/ARM CPU architectures (e.g. s390x, RISC-V), stated performance or feature limits for PowerPC, independent or hands-on corroboration of PowerPC inference.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on diverse CPU architectures beyond x86 and ARM, such as PowerPC

citations.quote: Support for NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and x86/ARM/PowerPC CPUs.
